answer_1.quote: The LLM is free to recommend any number of products in its preferred ordering. Retrieved rankings are then compared to control ones, in which no product is attacked.
answer_1.outputs: Generated product recommendation lists (ranked textual lists)

answer_2.quote: We use two key metrics: Recommendation rate (Rate) – how often a product is recommended by the LLM, and Recommendation position (Pos) – the rank or order in which the product appears when it is recommended. We also include standard ranking metrics, such as Mean Reciprocal Rank (MRR).
